title: Palatinate campaign
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Palatinate campaign", at revision 1370701879, opens: "The Palatinate campaign, also known as the Spanish conquest of the Palatinate or the Palatinate phase of the Thirty Years' War, was a campaign conducted by the Imperial army of the Holy Roman Empire against the Protestant Union in the Lower Palatinate, during the Thirty Years' War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7126801, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1620 military campaign during the Thirty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
